pages.text: $(item)Draconium$() is the base metal of the mod: nearly every Draconic Evolution recipe uses it somewhere, directly or through a $(l:getting_started/cores)Core$(/l).$(br2)It comes as ore, $(item)Dust$(), $(item)Nuggets$(), $(item)Ingots$() and $(item)Blocks$(). Ore drops dust, and dust smelts 1:1 into ingots. Nine nuggets make an ingot and nine ingots make a block, and both go back the other way.

pages.title: Where to find it
pages.text: Draconium ore generates in three dimensions:$(li)$(l)Overworld$(): deep down at Y -64 to -48, in roughly one chunk out of ten, as small veins in stone or deepslate.$(li)$(l)Nether$(): Y 4 to 16, about one chunk in thirty, but in big veins.$(li)$(l)End$(): three small veins in every chunk, Y 0 to 70, on the main island and the outer islands.
On this server Overworld ore is rare. $(l)The End is the main source$(), so plan your Draconium trips there.

pages.title: Mining
pages.text: Mine any of the ores with a pickaxe. Each one drops 2 to 4 $(item)Draconium Dust$(), and Fortune adds up to one more per level.$(br2)Silk Touch gives the ore block, which smelts into only one ingot, so Fortune is the better choice.

pages.title: Other sources
pages.text: Killing the $(item)Ender Dragon$() also drops a large pile of Draconium Dust (about 64 by default), and a $(item)Dragon Heart$() for $(l:getting_started/awakened_draconium)Awakened Draconium$(/l).$(br2)On this server, $(item)Mystical Agriculture$() can also turn Draconium Essence into ingots; check JEI.$(br2)A $(item)Draconium Block$() resists the Wither and the Ender Dragon, and next to an enchanting table it counts as four bookshelves.
Ingots split into nine nuggets, and nine nuggets go back into an ingot.
